newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FORE Systems started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FORE Systems started.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst Martin Pyykkonen said he initiated coverage of FORE Systems Inc, adding the stock to the brokerage's recommended list.
-- He set a 12-month target price of $53.
-- He forecasts earnings of $0.52 a share for 1996 and $0.76 for 1997.

-- "As a premier networking equipment vendor and leader in ATM (asynchronous transfer mode) technology, we believe FORE is positioned to benefit from the emergence of ATM from niche applications to more mainstream networks, especially in large-enterprise and wide-area networks," Pyykkonen said in a research note.
-- The stock was up 5/8 at 42 in Nasdaq trading on Tuesday afternoon.
